hypothesis: A residual causal encoder trained on original public speech, with bounded synthetic command augmentation, improves exact typed slot recognition without unacceptable human-command or OOV regressions.
initialization: random neural weights; shared selected human foundation for matched continuation arms

training.foundation_selection: maximum human development raw exact commands, then minimum human development OOV candidate errors, then earliest epoch
training.continuation_selection: maximum mean of human and synthetic development positive raw exact recall, then minimum combined negative candidate errors, then earliest epoch
training.matched_step_budget: ceil(human_train_count / 48) optimizer steps each epoch in both arms
training.source_audio_transform: original mono 16 kHz audio only; no stochastic noise, pitch, speed or splicing

data.fsc_splits: existing official train/test and speaker-separated dev/calibration from original validation
data.slurp_splits: SHA256(pcv-human-slots-v1/slurp/SPEAKER) first 12 hex modulo 1000; train <700, dev <800, calibration <900, otherwise test; paired microphones stay with speaker
synthetic: existing Qwen with original held-out voice splits
local SAPI: David train, Mark development, Zira test
data.sapi_limitation: one test voice from one engine, not a full cross-engine speech qualification; generated prompts not independently listened
data.source_semantics: exact finite membership for command targets; conservative published family labels only for auxiliary intent supervision

calibration.selection_source: calibration split only; model weights selected before calibration
calibration.no_feasible_policy: disabled; retain raw rankings and report failure

qualification.baseline: all prescribed exact spoken cases, with per-phrase denominators and separate engine/speaker strata
